title: sync_to_disk_lands_beside_a_watching_daemon_and_costs_it_no_ingest flakes under load
body: The intent-cli integration test sync_to_disk_lands_beside_a_watching_daemon_and_costs_it_no_ingest (native/rust/crates/intent-cli/tests/sync_to_disk_runs_beside_a_watching_daemon.rs:195) failed on the 3.3.3 cut's first kovacs leg (at 484ea426e) under load and then passed on its re-run with no code change. It is a timing assertion that depends on the machine's load. Make it deterministic: synchronise on the daemon's own signal, not on elapsed time. Found during the 3.3.3 cut on 2026-11-15; devbin's side is its todo 217.
